speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). While your history of ulcerative colitis and sexual activity raise concerns for drug-induced liver injury or infectious hepatitis, the combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, and abnormal liver function tests in a young female (note: patient details mentioned "male" in one sentence but the classic presentation of PBC is strongly associated with women; however, drug-induced cholestasis from azathioprine or infectious causes remain differential diagnoses). I have already requested the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel; pending results, I must emphasize that if Alkaline Phosphatase is disproportionately elevated compared to transaminases and you are positive for anti-mitochondrial antibodies (which I will now request), this confirms PBC. REQUEST TEST: Anti-mitochondrial Antibody (AMA) and Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy Panel (to rule out other cholestatic causes).
